clauses.claim: SVG lacks a usable stated original size
clauses.assessment: ashiglaju bolqu restricts original size to a usable value; jigaγ-a ügei denies its specification by SVG. It does not deny every declaration or merely say the file is absent.

clauses.claim: No canvas-derived substitute was used
clauses.assessment: Canvas-size noun takes front-vowel dative dü as the basis of ündüsülegsen; that participle modifies the substitute-size head. tegun-u oron-du refers back to original size. ashiglaγsan ügei negates use, not ability or the existence of a possible replacement.

clauses.claim: Original SVG size exceeds Android bitmap dimensional bound
clauses.assessment: The subject remains the original SVG-image size; the comparison is against Android bitmap-image size limit. No file-byte, RAM or megapixel budget is imported. Latin bitmap preserves identity.

clauses.claim: No resizing occurred
clauses.assessment: General change of size is the object of a completed negative; neither automatic-only nor shrink-only modification is present.

residual_idiom_script_uncertainty: Pronoun reference is coherent, but repeating original size could be more idiomatic in a future fluent edit.
Long based-on phrase, original/intrinsic terminology, technical bitmap loan and traditional spacing/shaping need fluent/editorial and on-device review.

clauses.claim: SVG lacks a usable stated original size
clauses.assessment: SVG de supplies the file location. araha and baitalame mutere restrict da kemun; existential akū denies that usable recorded original value. Ordinary writing in a file is sufficient declaration paraphrase.

clauses.claim: No canvas-derived substitute was used
clauses.assessment: nirure ba i kemun i songkoi governs the basis of determining; toktobuha modifies replacement kemun be. da kemun i funde marks the original displaced value. baitalahakū negates the use event. No object or direction reversal found.

clauses.claim: Original SVG size exceeds Android bitmap dimensional bound
clauses.assessment: SVG i da kemun is subject; Android i bitmap i kemun i dalba be is the exceeded bound. The explicit dimension noun keeps the Latin technical identity from becoming a file-size or memory warning.

clauses.claim: No resizing occurred
clauses.assessment: amba ajige be is the size object of completed negative halahakū. The automatic adverb has been removed without introducing a prohibition, inability, future or not-yet claim.

residual_idiom_script_uncertainty: Stacked participles and genitive chain are grammatical source-assisted compositions, not modern UI idiom attestation.
Abstract dimensional funde complement and bitmap loan remain editorial choices; no human-only grammar restriction was found.
Manchu glyph shaping and line wrapping were not rendered.

changes.why: The alternatives are verbal predicates, so use verbal ki support rather than the nominal copula ne. Apply only to this proposed sentence; existing catalogue examples are not acceptance.

clauses.claim: SVG lacks a usable stated original size
clauses.assessment: The topic is original size recorded in SVG, not SVG itself. Absence and inability to use are alternatives. This preserves missing-or-unusable information, but the original ne after verbal alternatives needs ki support. Generic a= marks the writer/user, not an alleged passive suffix.

clauses.claim: No canvas-derived substitute was used
clauses.assessment: Inner ani identifies canvas-size input to making a size. Outer ani marks that derived replacement value; unmarked hoski pororu is the affected object of itasare. The generic actor is supplied by a=. Negation scopes over the whole replacement event. The two nested adjuncts are heavy but intelligible.

clauses.claim: Original SVG size exceeds Android bitmap dimensional bound
clauses.assessment: Original size is compared with the allowable extent for setting Android Bitmap width and height. The coordinated axes occur inside the range expression, not as two separate asserted overflows. Nothing explicitly requires both axes to exceed.

clauses.claim: No resizing occurred
clauses.assessment: Size is the object of generic-agent causative change sinnare under ka somo ki. The error-event context supplies completed non-action; absence of obligatory past inflection is not a future-policy claim. No automatic or shrink restriction remains.

residual_idiom_script_uncertainty: Nested ani phrases and abstract replacement with itasare need fluent idiom review. The catalogue role example is corroborating composition evidence, not a native-certified template.

pororu is an existing coinage; sinnare is retained as transparent sinna plus causative morphology. No exact primary lexical entry for the complete sinnare form was established. That absence alone is not proof of bad meaning.
Collective width/height range and absent-or-unusable coordination remain stylistically heavy. Generic-agent error-register and all lexical choices require qualified review.

Use independently attested target-language determine stem. This is not a finding that the old catalogue spelling is inherently invalid; it avoids relying on that catalogue alone.

clauses.claim: SVG lacks a usable stated original size
clauses.assessment: File-locative/topic SVGんかいや and the size subject under written-resultative negative retain recorded original dimensions. Required potential ちかーりーる makes usability explicit; ordinary ちかゆる alone does not securely express that ability.

clauses.claim: No canvas-derived substitute was used
clauses.assessment: The canvas size is instrumental/basis; the resulting determined size is the topical object of non-use. The original size is explicitly the replacement target. Polite negative past ちかやびらんたん reports non-use. The final value uses documented ちわみたる, without asserting that catalogue 決みたる is proven invalid.

clauses.claim: Original SVG size exceeds Android bitmap dimensional bound
clauses.assessment: The yaka comparison says original SVG size is larger than the upper limit of Android bitmap dimensions. It contains no file-byte or memory-budget qualification. Technical loan nouns do not replace Okinawan predicate/case structure.

clauses.claim: No resizing occurred
clauses.assessment: The size-change operation is nominalized and topicalized; さびらんたん denies having done it. General change and completed negative are supported separately. No automatic-only modifier, shrink predicate or future prohibition remains.

residual_idiom_script_uncertainty: Shuri/Naha-oriented written register, Han/Kana loanword spelling and the long bitmap-bound noun chain still need fluent editorial review.
Potential forms can also have passive uses; the inanimate usable-size restriction and actual primary usability examples support the intended potential reading here.
The final choice ちわみたる is an explicit new-string lexical recommendation, not unrelated catalogue cleanup.

MN-ACADEMY-BASIS.checked: Full public dictionary entry opened independently.
MN-ACADEMY-BASIS.supports: Figurative based-on sense, traditional spelling ündüsülekü, and dative basis examples. Not merely the botanical root sense.

MN-IMU-ABSTRACT.checked: Indexed full abstract independently retrieved; direct open failed. 2019/5 Chifeng University Mongolian philosophy/social-science journal, author Hai Siya.
MN-IMU-ABSTRACT.supports: The university-characteristics basis takes dative tu before ündüsülegsen. It is a genuine attributive based-on construction, not a transliteration from Cyrillic.

MN-IMU-TITLE.checked: Indexed 2026/1 Mongolian Studies issue title independently retrieved; direct open failed.
MN-IMU-TITLE.supports: The title contains sedkilge-dü ündüsülegsen, corroborating the front-vowel dative used after the candidate size noun. Article body not checked.

MN-HSIAO.checked: Read supplied official-download PDF text locally, especially printed pp.500 and510, example20 and its contrast with21. The supplied local PDF is identified in input_hashes.
MN-HSIAO.supports: Postverbal nominal/perfective negation with ügei; the completed-action negative is distinct from nonpast. This is morphology evidence, not certification of UI style.

MNC-PORTER.checked: Full three-page primary teaching PDF independently opened.
MNC-PORTER.supports: akū negates existence or participles; perfective negative denotes non-action, distinct from prohibition and not-yet. halambi is general change/correct.

MNC-ELLIOTT.checked: Primary teaching PDF independently opened, pp.1–3.
MNC-ELLIOTT.supports: Pre-head participles, completed -ha forms, -me with ability auxiliaries; ordinary document-writing and object-before-verb examples.

MNC-MOELLENDORFF.checked: Authored public-domain grammar transcription independently inspected, verb paradigm, negative forms and syntax.
MNC-MOELLENDORFF.supports: araha is written/past write; pre-head participles and mutere noun modifiers; objects precede verbs. Historical descriptive grammar, not a modern terminology standard.

MNC-GORELOVA.bibliography: Liliya M. Gorelova, Manchu Grammar, Brill,2002.
MNC-GORELOVA.checked: Identifiable authored grammar on a non-publisher mirror; independently inspected printed pp.345–347 and363 (PDF369–371,387).
MNC-GORELOVA.supports: funde and songkoi govern genitive complements. funde has replacement/stead meaning; songkoi expresses conformity/basis. Generic nominal governance does not impose a human-only complement restriction.

MNC-TEXT.checked: Aligned Manchu and translation independently opened.
MNC-TEXT.supports: sarganjui i funde illustrates the displaced/represented person as genitive complement. Extending this role to a dimensional value is compositional, not an attested computer phrase.

AIN-TAMURA-GRAMMAR.checked: National Ainu Museum reproduction of Tamura1996 grammar; independently read sections2,4,6–8.
AIN-TAMURA-GRAMMAR.supports: Pre-head modification, unmarked third-person objects, indefinite transitive a=, auxiliary eaykap and productive causatives. No obligatory past-tense inflection. These support composition but do not themselves attest each technical lexeme.

AIN-NINJAL-GRAMMAR.checked: Primary corpus introduction and grammar independently opened.
AIN-NINJAL-GRAMMAR.supports: a= is fourth-person transitive-subject marking with contextual functions. An unmarked object is distinct from an ani instrumental adjunct. Generic-agent analysis here does not assume a universal passive.

AIN-TAMURA-HENE-NEGATION.checked: Museum dictionary page independently opened; Tamura hene, ka/somo and verb examples inspected. Direct hene query failed, but this indexed page yielded the entries.
AIN-TAMURA-HENE-NEGATION.supports: Repeated hene presents alternatives; verbal uses have ki support. ka somo ki denies an operation and permits completed-event readings in context.

AIN-YOSHIKAWA.bibliography: Yoshimi Yoshikawa, Modality in the Saru dialect of Ainu, ILR29; received2024-11-10.
AIN-YOSHIKAWA.checked: Full authored primary paper opened; PDFp.7 examples29–32 checked.
AIN-YOSHIKAWA.supports: Contrast between verbal apto as hene ki and nominal apto hene ne supports changing the candidate verbal coordination tail to ki. The new SVG coordination remains an editorial composition.

AIN-TAMURA-SINNA.checked: Museum entry independently opened and indexed headword checked.
AIN-TAMURA-SINNA.supports: sinna is an intransitive different/separate predicate; sinnayno is analyzed as sinna plus an inserted y and adverbial no. The candidate sinnare is analyzed compositionally as causative change, not inferred from an unrelated language.

AIN-OOTA.bibliography: Mitsuru Oota, Japanese–Ainu Dictionary, Draft Version,2022-12-20; Hokkaido University Ainu and Indigenous Studies Center archive.
AIN-OOTA.checked: Official20,516,912-byte PDF fetched independently and relevant entry read locally; direct web renderer failed.
AIN-OOTA.supports: Entry 換える labels itasare transitive, with an object exchanged for another thing. Its 新 label identifies modern composition and does not certify community acceptance. Only this lexical entry was used, not its unrelated material.

AIN-MODERN-LEXICON.checked: Public named modern glossary introduction opened; supplied v2 exact lexical capture inspected.
AIN-MODERN-LEXICON.supports: pororu is a documented existing size coinage. This establishes provenance, not native approval or a traditional computing sense.
